CPT® Code Description:
FusionMRD™ Monitoring, a lab test that looks for cancer cells in the blood to see if a person still has signs of cancer after
treatment

Plasma Detect Genome MRD – Baseline, an initial lab test that looks for certain gene findings that can be linked to a cancer
and can be used with other tests done later to see if a person still has signs of cancer after treatment

Plasma Detect Genome MRD – Monitoring, a lab test that looks for cancer cells in the blood to see if a person still has signs
of cancer after treatment

Oncomine Dx Express Test, a lab test done to look for errors in genes that can predict how well a drug might work for treating
certain lung cancers
MAP-AD, a lab test done to look for certain markers linked to Alzheimer's disease

CKM PGx™ Panel (Hypertension and Cardiovascular-kidney-metabolic pharmacogenetic panel), a lab tests done to look for
gene errors that may impact how the body responds to certain drugs

OncoDx™ (Hereditary Germline Cancer Genetics Panel), a lab test done to look for gene errors that can cause high risks for
certain cancers

RenaPGx™ (Renal Pharmacogenetic Test), a lab tests done to look for gene errors that may impact how the body responds
to certain drugs

RenaXome™ (Renal Disease Whole Exome Sequencing), a lab test done to look for errors in the parts of all the genes that
make proteins and can cause kidney disease

GenomeDx Rapid, Comparator, a lab test that compares genome results between family members and reports results faster
than with standard testing
GenomeDx Rapid, Proband, a lab test that looks for errors in the genome and reports results faster than with standard testing

GenomeDx ultraRapid, Proband, a lab test that looks for errors in the genome and reports results much faster than with
standard testing
